## Quarto

Quarto enables you to weave together content and executable code into a finished document. To learn more about Quarto see <https://quarto.org>.

## Running Code

When you click the **Render** button a document will be generated that includes both content and the output of embedded code. You can embed code like this:

```{r}
1 + 1
```

You can add options to executable code like this

```{r}
#| echo: false
2 * 2
```

The `echo: false` option disables the printing of code (only output is displayed).

```{r}
library(odbc) # provides drivers to connect to different SQL dialects
library(DBI)  # provides functions to interact with the database
library(sf) # Bibliothèque pour l'analyse et traitement des données spatiales
library(tidyverse) # Data science tools
library(mapview) # Visu rapide et dynamique des objets spatiaux
```

```{sql}

CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS postgis;
CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS data;

CREATE TABLE data.bixi_stations (
    station_id   TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    external_id  TEXT,
    name         TEXT,
    short_name   TEXT,
    capacity     INTEGER,
    rental_methods TEXT[],
    is_charging  BOOLEAN,
    has_kiosk    BOOLEAN,
    geom         GEOMETRY(Point, 4326)
);

CREATE TEMP TABLE tmp_bixi (data jsonb);
COPY tmp_bixi FROM '/chemin/vers/bixi.json';  -- chemin côté serveur PostgreSQL



```
